Vetting needs: vetting_status field on candidate profiles (none/screened/interviewed/vetted), a badge on card and profile, a buyer-side filter, an admin view to set status, and a funnel event per stage.

Signal to show buyers once real: vetted/interviewed badge plus the pass criteria (technical depth, English, async habits, USD pay expectation, overlap hours). No vetted count or pass rate until it is in docs/metrics.md.

Decide: (1) vetted = live interview only, or two badges (Verified without your time, Interviewed with your time); (2) a weekly hour budget for interviews and meetups. Without them M3 300 vetted is not reachable.

By M6 investors will ask for each pilot's start date, roles, days to first match, interviews, hires, pilot-to-paid and 2-3 buyer quotes. Log every pilot in data/leads.csv and every reply in docs/feedback.md from the first call.

By M6 investors will ask for 8+ weeks of demo=false weekly counts (signups by side, roles posted, matches, first messages) plus a retention signal (team posts a 2nd role; candidate active after 30 days). Get funnel events into production and add a retention event.

YC W27: apply on time with a lean application (about 6h over 6 days, on top of the selling hour), only if you answer yes to both by Wed 10/28: (1) can you be in SF Jan-Mar 2027, (2) can you add about 1h/day until 11/2. Otherwise apply to a later batch with pilot data.
M1 pilot shortlist and offer drafted: only 4 verified targets (Railway, Cal.com, Inngest, GoGoGrandparent), not 10; 3 pilots from 4 needs a very high conversion rate.

Niche buyers hire senior backend, infra and full-stack engineers plus front-end TS; vet for those stacks first. GoGoGrandparent needs 4+ hrs US overlap: vet for evening-shift willingness and async habits. No 'vetted' in copy until the founder defines it.

Pilots need: salary, stack, seniority and overlap hours visible on roles before swiping; a per-pilot funnel view without SQL; candidate fields for English level and overlap window; a notification when a team likes a candidate. No first match in 7 days = dead pilot.

Only 4 qualified niche leads; Ashby job boards are unreadable by agent tools. Spend 10 min/week checking 15-20 remote-first dev-tools ATS boards in a browser, or decide by 2026-11-10 whether to widen the niche. Set the per-hire fee amount via /ceo before any pilot call.
